reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset, and Brown attribute Zattu's hundred-person gap to the two registers being compiled years apart in Babylon and Judea, amid attrition.

discrepancy.emptyNote: C. Dennis McKinsey catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: C. Dennis McKinsey, The Encyclopedia of Biblical Errancy (1995).
